## 1. What an eForm is

- A classic CLM eForm is an HTML form that an administrator builds in CLM. A submitted form becomes a `.sxform` document in a chosen folder [brief] [observed].
- Fields bound to CLM **attributes** write those attributes onto the `.sxform`. The values can be searched, reported on and used by workflows [brief] [observed].
- Plain HTML controls (`<input>`, `<select>`, `<textarea>`, checkbox) with an `id` are saved too, as **custom form data**. They are not attributes: not searchable, not in reports, not in the attribute panel [doc] [observed].
- A form can carry attachments. Each file becomes its own document in the submit folder, linked to the `.sxform` as a related document [observed].

## 2. eForm, Doc Gen form or Agreement Desk? [brief]

| Use | When | Output |
|---|---|---|
| **eForm** (classic) | A repeatable intake or task with known questions; the answers route, classify or update metadata; the record should stay in CLM | A `.sxform` document with attributes and custom data |
| **Document Generation form** | The goal is a contract from a template; fields map to merge tags and conditions | A generated agreement |
| **Agreement Desk** request | The intake is a conversation: triage, collaboration, redlines and back-and-forth | A request with its own workspace |

Combine them: an eForm captures the request and a workflow starts a Doc Gen form for the contract [brief]. Keep the first form short; ask specialist questions in a later task; explain why sensitive questions are asked [brief].

## 3. Where eForms live and what you can set [observed]

- **Admin ▸ Automation Tools ▸ eForms** = `/clm/Forms/BrowseForms.aspx`. It is not under `/clm/Admin/`; `/clm/Admin/FormConfig` is the Document Generation form list.
- The list shows Submit Folder, Workflow, May Submit, May Update Form Documents, Repository Attachments and Attachment Required.
- **Form** menu: Create, Edit, Delete. **Edit ▸ Save As** is the copy: it copies the HTML only, not the submit folder, workflow or switches.
- **Routing**: Set Submit Folder, Set Workflow (any published workflow), Clear Workflow.
- **Access**: Allow / Disable Submission, Allow / Disable Updates, Enable / Disable Repository Attachments (link documents already in CLM), Attachment Required / Not Required.
- There is no public / private choice anywhere in this account's UI. The CLM Admin Guide says new public eForms can no longer be created [brief].
- **Saving an edit turns off May Submit and May Update.** Turn them on again after every save. Repository Attachments and Attachment Required stay. Also in [video 8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=435Y4UHCXoo).
- An edit applies to every `.sxform` already submitted: they open with the new HTML [observed] [video 8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=435Y4UHCXoo).
- eForms have no versions; Save As before a risky change [video 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YCfM5bG-8Y0).
- The designer: a name, the attribute picker (only attributes that are in an attribute group), **Generate Sample Form**, **Append Selected Fields**, **Append Attachment Control**, an HTML text box and **Preview** (a dialog).
- Submitting: the form's page is `/clm/Forms/UpdateFormDoc.aspx?FormUid=…`. It makes `<form name>.sxform`; the next submissions are `(1)`, `(2)`… A submitted form opens as **View Form** (read only) or, with Allow Updates, as **Update Form**, which saves over the same `.sxform`.

## 4. The Fontara examples (kept in the account)

All forms submit to `eForms/<Process>/Submitted`. Each was submitted with zz-lab test data. Each mixes **attributes** (durable metadata) with **form answers** (custom inputs) — the hybrid design from [doc]. The account has no attributes for request type, value, NDA type, risk flags or dates, and CLM Admin ▸ Attributes is off limits to this repo, so those answers are custom inputs.

| eForm | Style | Configuration it shows | Attributes | Form answers (custom ids) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contract Request | Bootstrap 5 cards and grid | Loader; show the upload only when "On their paper" = Yes; a modal blocks Save without their draft (`SCM_FORM_BEFORE_DATA_PROCESS`); `required="true"` on a field | business unit, entity, requester, counterparty, relationship, contact, country, end date, governing law, third party | `crRequestType`, `crAgreementType`, `crPurpose`, `crValue`, `crEffective` |
| NDA Request | Clean single column, CSS only | A default for an attribute drop-down set by script (Delaware); no attachment | NDA business unit, entity, counterparty, region, signer, signer email, governing law, material return | `ndaType`, `ndaPurpose`, `ndaSignBy`, `ndaTheirPaper` |
| Vendor Onboarding | Sections with a review matrix table | Due-diligence section shown when data is internal, personal data is involved or the supplier connects; a repeating set; 2 attachment slots; Repository Attachments on | supplier, industry, region, country, contact, sponsor unit and entity, sponsor, classification, due-diligence items (repeating) | `voPersonalData`, `voConnectivity`, `voSpend`, `voCurrency`, `voAgreement` |
| Third-Party Paper Review | Attachment-first card | Attachment Required; CSS and a counterparty CSV loaded from CLM with the get handler; a known counterparty fills in its relationship | counterparty, relationship, contact email, classification, entity, unit, owner | `tppDocType`, `tppNeededBy`, `tppNotes` |
| Agreement Metadata Update | Compact table | Allow Updates: the `.sxform` reopens as Update Form; read-only attributes lock after the first save; Save relabelled "Save changes" | status, document type, counterparty, expiration, amendments, governing law, liability, owner, classification, agreement id (read only) | `fxChangeType`, `fxReason`, `fxEffective`, `fxUrgent`, `fxAck`, `fxNotes` |
| Redline Decisions (classic) / (improved) | See section 7 | A task form whose rows come from a JSON file; decisions saved as custom data | — | `decision1…6`, `clauseKey1…6`, `note1…6`, `counter1…6`, `clauseSnapshot`, `decisionSummary` |

Custom values cannot drive search, reports or attribute-based routing. A workflow can still read them from Params (section 5). Promote an answer to an attribute when it must be searched or reported [doc].

## 5. What a submission stores [observed]

- **Attributes** go on the `.sxform` (CLM REST `GET /v2/{account}/documents/{id}?expand=attributegroups`). Repeating sets come back per row.
- **Custom data** is the `.sxform` file itself: `GET {api}/content/v2/{account}/documents/{id}` with `Accept: */*` returns `[{"HtmlId":"crPurpose","HtmlValue":"…","CustomDataReference":""}, …]`. A form with no custom data stores `{}`. Empty fields are not stored.
- **In a workflow** started by the form (Routing ▸ Set Workflow), `Params ▸ Documents ▸ Document` holds the attributes as `<ExternalParty><BusinessName …>` and in `Metadata` / `MetadataGroup` lists, and the custom data twice: `CustomFormData` (exact `FieldId`, `SetName`, `SetNumber`) and `CustomFormFields/<id>`. In `CustomFormFields` the element name drops every character that is not a letter or digit (`under_score_id` → `underscoreid`). The run's Params is visible in the process monitor ▸ Params; `GET /v2/{account}/workflows/{id}` does not return it.
- **Attachments** (the attachment control or a custom file input) are separate documents in the submit folder, linked as attached and related documents. They do not get the form's attributes.

## 6. Styling eForms

the owner's three examples in the account (read only here) and the five Fontara styles:

| Style | Where | What it uses | Pick it when | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap grid matrix | the owner's **Approval Matrix** | Bootstrap 5.3.3 from jsDelivr (`<link>` + bundle `<script>`), `row`/`col-md-4`, floating labels, disabled selects | A read-only reference table inside a form | Plain inputs; values are custom data only |
| HTML summary table | the owner's **Table** | A `<table>` with CSS (black header, hover rows); jQuery relabels the bottom button "Return to Document" | Show a contract summary beside a task | Its script sets `style` on a jQuery object and throws (`Cannot set properties of undefined`) |
| Bootstrap floating labels | the owner's **Boostrap** | Bootstrap, SpringCM.UX script, a spinner until `SCM_FORM_AFTER_DATA_LOAD`, `SpringCM.API.get` | A modern full-page form | Preview never fires the load event, so it stays on "Loading…"; the form reads the account id from the page header and a document id from `ru=` |
| Bootstrap cards | Fontara Contract Request | Bootstrap CSS, `class="form-control/form-select"` passed through the springcm tag, badges, a modal | Polished intake for business users | External CSS from a CDN; the user picker chip is clipped by Bootstrap's box sizing |
| Single column | Fontara NDA Request | CSS only, labels above fields, full-width controls | Short forms, mobile | — |
| Sections + matrix | Fontara Vendor Onboarding | `<fieldset>` sections, a static review matrix, a script-driven section | Longer forms with optional parts | Show/hide is client-side only |
| Attachment-first card | Fontara Third-Party Paper Review | CSS from a file in CLM (get handler), CSS grid, a dashed drop zone | Upload-led intake | Version the CSS URL (`?v=2`): a browser keeps the old file |
| Compact table | Fontara Agreement Metadata Update | A `<table>` with group rows, zebra and notes | Admin and update forms | — |

the owner's **Amendment** form is a launcher, not an intake: it reads the document it was opened from (`ru` URL parameter), reads its attributes with `SpringCM.API.get`, builds Doc Gen XML and posts `/v2/{account}/doclaunchertasks`, then redirects to the generated form. Its ids are hard-coded for another account, so it does not run here [observed: HTML only].

## 7. Redline Decisions: a task form fed by an agent

The use case: a workflow's agent step compares the counterparty's latest version with the playbook and lists the changed clauses with a suggestion each. Legal decides per clause; the workflow then builds the response.

**How the clause list reaches the form** (realistic for CLM):
1. The agent step writes the list as a JSON file (here `Fontara eForms/Assets/redline-northbridge-round1.json`, 4 sample clauses).
2. The form reads it with the get handler (`/clm/atlas/documents/get.ashx/<folder path>/<file>`) when it first opens, renders one card per clause, and copies the JSON into a hidden custom field, `clauseSnapshot`. A reopened form renders from its own snapshot, so the record keeps what Legal saw.
3. Decisions go into pre-declared hidden custom inputs, `decision1…6`, with `clauseKey1…6`, `note1…6` and (improved) `counter1…6`. They must exist in the HTML before CLM starts: CLM renames every custom control at load, so an input a script creates later is not saved [observed].
4. A workflow reads `Params…CustomFormFields.decision1` and `clauseKey1`, or the `.sxform` content through the API.

For a real run the workflow would write one JSON per request and pass its path; this repo did not build that workflow (the account has no agent step). Other ways a workflow can put data in front of a form: attributes it sets before an Edit Form task, or Doc Gen XML [brief] [video 7](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xxP-aNGBNqY).

**Classic vs improved**

| | Classic | Improved |
|---|---|---|
| Layout | As the screenshot: brand bar, tiles, cards, Approve/Reject toggle, sticky footer | Progress bar, risk colour stripe, old → new diff, collapsible clause text |
| Speed | One click per clause | **Accept all agent suggestions**, then filter **Undecided** or **Overrides** |
| Options | Approve, Reject | Approve, Reject, **Counter** with a counter-proposal field that appears only then |
| Rules | None; Submit always saves | A reason is required when overriding the agent; Submit is blocked (`SCM_FORM_BEFORE_DATA_PROCESS` returns false) until every clause is decided and explained |
| Access | Buttons | `role="radiogroup"`, `aria-checked`, arrow keys, focus rings, live status, contrast, stacks on narrow screens |
